events.name: Black and White Wet Look
events.description: A high-contrast black and white close-up of your face against pure black, soaking wet hair framing it and clear water droplets on your skin, like a dramatic studio portrait.

events.name: Boom Clap Confetti
events.description: In a bright white room you sing Boom Clap straight to the phone, and two confetti cannons fired from behind the camera rain white, then gold confetti down on you while you laugh and catch it.

events.name: Convertible Drift
events.description: You at the wheel of a red convertible, top down, filming yourself as you spin donuts through thick white tyre smoke, then a big grin into the lens.

events.name: Dance With Santa
events.description: You dance side by side with Santa Claus on a red carpet between two lit Christmas trees, a bouncy step forward and back with turns, in one full-length take.

events.name: GTA 6 Car Wash
events.description: In a sunny GTA 6 style street, you pressure-wash a black SUV, scrub its wheel, polish the bonnet with a towel, and MISSION PASSED +$500 pops up.

events.name: GTA 6 Nightclub
events.description: A GTA-style night out in 12 seconds: a silver supercar glides down a neon beachfront strip and stops outside a club, you climb out under the scissor door, stroll past the bouncer into the neon doorway, and dance in the middle of a packed floor under lasers.

events.name: GTA 6 Phone on the Beach
events.description: Cruising a sunny GTA 6 beach in first person, the driver holds up a phone and stares at it while the car ploughs through beachgoers, and on that phone screen is you (or your pet) on a live video call.

events.name: GTA 6 Wanted Level
events.description: A game-style wanted escape in one 10-second take: you stroll toward the lens on a pastel art-deco beachfront with a minimap and five wanted stars on screen, turn away, jog to a yellow supercar, climb in under its scissor door and speed off down a palm-lined boulevard into a pink sunset as a helicopter and two police cars give chase.

events.name: Guzarishon Pe
events.description: You hold up a floral book in a tie-dye top, two see-through glimpses of your festive look flash over you, the book sweeps across the lens and you come back in a cream festive suit with a white letter, on the Guzarish song.

events.name: Needs More Salt
events.description: One of you tastes the soup and says it needs more salt; the other only pretends to add it, and the next taste is perfect.

events.name: Waiting On My Fries
events.description: You behind a taco shop counter, sending your coworker off to make the forgotten fries and doing a slow dance right at the customer's phone.
